page_title: WOL 0-2 BHA | Wolves v Brighton 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Fabian Hurzeler decides to make a substitution. Yasin Ayari will be replaced by Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' It is time for a substitution. Matheus Mane (Wolves) is on for Andre.
89' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
85' 0 - 2 GOAL! Brajan Gruda (Brighton) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Jose Sa, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:2.
82' A wild pass somehow finds Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
80' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) replaces Yankuba Minteh.
79' Today's match ends for Carlos Baleba who will be replaced by Diego Gomez (Brighton).
75' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Shots on target – 3:1.
69' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jose Sa is quickest to intercept the ball.
68' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
65' Simon Adingra (Brighton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
64' Brighton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
63' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just over the bar.
60' Substitution. Joao Gomes did his best and is replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
59' That's the end of the game for Tariq Lamptey, who is replaced by Simon Adingra (Brighton).
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Matheus Cunha walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves).
59' Here is a change. Goncalo Guedes is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
59' Here comes a substitution. Matt O'Riley is given a rest as he is replaced by Brajan Gruda (Brighton).
59' Vitor Pereira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) replacing Matt Doherty.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing.
58' A snap shot by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Bart Verbruggen produces a good save to thwart him.
54' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
49' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
48' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' What was Mats Wieffer (Brighton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Wolves take a short corner kick.
44' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Bart Verbruggen into a superb diving save to keep it out.
40' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar!
34' The percentage of ball possession is – 56:44.
32' Pervis Estupinan (Brighton) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
29' 0 - 1 Goal! Danny Welbeck (Brighton) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Jose Sa into the bottom right corner.
28' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
27' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
27' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Oliver blows for a foul. We are about to witness a penalty kick. The referee points directly to the penalty spot.
26' The goal by Brighton is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
25' Wait! Referee Michael Oliver has indicated he is going to review the Brighton goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
23' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) converts a killer cross with a precise low shot that goes into the bottom left corner. What a brilliant finish!
21' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
20' The game is interrupted now, Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brighton.
18' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Toti (Wolves), whose header goes wide of the goal.
13' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' Wolves are seeing far more of the ball now.
7' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort just over the crossbar!
6' Matt O'Riley (Brighton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
6' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.
3' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
3' Joao Gomes (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
2' Poor challenge! Matt O'Riley (Brighton) is penalised for tripping and Michael Oliver blows his whistle.
1' Tariq Lamptey (Brighton) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver was nominated as the referee for this game.
